apple_silicon_install_upgrade.evidence: Universal DMG and arm64 slice were inspected on an Apple Silicon Mac. Installing and upgrading the app on a real Apple Silicon system was not tested.

intel_install_upgrade.evidence: The x86_64 slice cross-builds and targets macOS 13.0. No physical Intel Mac installation or upgrade was tested.

macos_13.evidence: Both executable slices declare macOS 13.0 as their minimum. Runtime behavior on macOS 13 was not tested.

visual_keyboard_voiceover.evidence: Automated UI regression tests passed. A complete visual, keyboard, and VoiceOver review of the 1.1.0 app was not performed.

real_soc_print_queue_cancel.evidence: No live SoC print, queue, or cancellation operation was performed during this validation.

keychain_account_switching.evidence: Keychain integration has automated coverage, but real account switching and credential retrieval after app restart were not observed.

real_soc_jump_enrollment_preservation.evidence: The user supplied a terminal transcript showing successful manual jump-key registration and the resulting ED25519 fingerprint. The app-driven merge, preservation, readback, and key-only access flow was not run against the SoC service.

managed_key_passphrase_keychain_restart.evidence: Automated tests verify that the passphrase is not returned by the UI bridge and Keychain persistence is required before enrollment. A real managed key was not enrolled and unlocked after app restart.

maintainer_attestation.testing_statement: Automated release checks passed; device-specific and live SoC checks below are explicitly marked incomplete.
maintainer_attestation.publication_authorization: The maintainer requested publication of v1.1.0 using the existing ad-hoc distribution method.

The supplied manual registration transcript is recorded as context, not as app validation.
